text: The Texas Senate race still neck and neck. It now appears the candidates are going to be taking the stage together.

Democratic State Representative James Talarico says he has agreed to three televised debates against Republican Attorney General Ken Paxton. Talarico says the first will happen September 22nd in the Rio Grande Valley with two
more following in October. However, we also reached out to Paxton's camp who told us they are close to terms on only one debate and will announce that soon.
So, we've got two different stories here.
